items.t: Prediction: Broadcom Stock Could Have Another Big Year as AI Chip Revenue Accelerates
items.sum: Broadcom has slipped this year after a report that Google is trimming AI chip shipments, yet Wall Street still sees huge upside. What would have to go right in 2027 for the stock to nearly double, and what could derail it?

items.t: Broadcom’s 2027 Bull Case: AI Revenue Doubles to $115B and $230B—Here’s What Finally Unlocks the Stock
items.sum: Broadcom's AI chip business is exploding, yet the stock keeps sliding while Wall Street piles on bullish targets. A bold 2027 scenario hinges on a few customer ramps and one valuation shift, and the math may surprise skeptics.

items.t: Broadcom Makes More AI Money Than AMD—So Why Is AMD’s Stock Crushing It?
items.sum: One chip giant books far more AI revenue, yet its stock sinks while its smaller rival soars. Investors are betting on a growth curve, but cash flow, inventory, and a December earnings date could change who looks smarter.

items.t: Why Is Broadcom Stock Rallying Today?
